title: Delivery
summary: What you share, and what is locked after init.

questions.prompt: What is the one shareable item?
questions.summary: The item a team installs to start.

options.label: Full boilerplate
options.why: The shareable item is the full system: tokens, CSS and components.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if a team should start from a full boilerplate.
trade_offs: The package is heavier than tokens alone

options.label: Tokens only
options.why: The shareable item is the token file only, and components stay in the app.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if each app owns its components.

questions.prompt: Which choices are locked after init?
questions.summary: Locked fields must not drift after the boilerplate is installed.

options.label: Lock tiers, pairing, and CSS variables
options.why: Token tiers, the on-color pair and CSS variable names are locked after init.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if those choices must not drift after setup.
trade_offs: A later rename is a breaking change

options.label: Lock nothing
options.why: Nothing is locked, so any choice can change after init.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if you are still exploring the system.
